{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

display(trial_df.head())

display(trial_df.info())

display(trial_df.describe(include='all'))

# Check for duplicates
n_duplicates = trial_df.duplicated().sum()

# Check for sentinel values (e.g., -999, 999, etc.)
sentinel_values = [999, -999, 9999, -9999, 'NA', 'N/A', 'null', 'NULL', '']

sentinel_counts = {}
for col in trial_df.columns:
    if trial_df[col].dtype == 'object':
        sentinel_counts[col] = trial_df[col].isin(sentinel_values).sum()
    else:
        sentinel_counts[col] = trial_df[col].isin(sentinel_values).sum()

# Print sentinel counts
sentinel_counts = {k: v for k, v in sentinel_counts.items() if v > 0}

# Final count of patients
n_patients = len(trial_df)

# Report findings
print(f'Number of patients: {n_patients}')
print(f'Duplicates: {n_duplicates}')
print(f'Sentinel values: {sentinel_counts}')"}
